hero.style: Full height or 80vh, warm background or large image with bg-black/40 overlay, massive centered or left-aligned typography.
hero.instructions: Use the wood-fired oven image or the close-up pizza image as a background or side-by-side. Include the Pizzeria San Francisco name prominently.

menu_list.instructions: Each category has a large H2. Each pizza item should be a flex container. Top row: Name, flex-1 border-b-2 border-dotted border-border/50 mx-4, then the 3 prices (Tonda, Taglio, Maxi) in a compact grid or flex. Bottom row: ingredients in italic.

qr_code_section.instructions: Use a simple QR code SVG or library. Include a 'Scarica / Download' button (Shadcn Button customized with primary color).

footer.style: Darker contrasting background or deeply warm surface (#2A2421 background with #FDFBF7 text).
footer.instructions: Include Address, Phone (with tel: link), Opening Hours, and Social placeholders (Instagram, TikTok). Use Phosphor icons or Lucide.

language_toggle.instructions: Place in header. Toggle state manages simple text swapping.

motion.hover: Subtle translate-y-1 on buttons, color transitions duration-200.
motion.scroll: Smooth scroll for menu category anchors.

hero_image.description: Wood fired pizza oven with warm glow

about_image.description: Close up of Neapolitan pizza with fresh basil

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Google Fonts 'Playfair Display' and 'Work Sans' in the global CSS.
Build a sticky header with the language toggle (IT/EN) and a primary 'Prenota' (Call) CTA.
Implement the menu section using the editorial layout: Item name, dotted line, then Prices (Tonda/Taglio/Maxi) aligned to the right. Use the provided ingredients.

The menu needs 7 categories: Pizze Classiche, Pizze Speciali, Pizze per Bambini, Pizze Bianche, Pizze con Pesce, Dolci, Bevande. Ensure you mock or iterate through a substantial list to represent ~70 pizzas, but you can render an array of 20-30 varied examples if writing all 70 is too verbose, just make it look dense and realistic.
Add a dedicated QR code download section using an SVG QR representation or a library like `qrcode.react`, with a button to trigger a download.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Do NOT use pure #000000 or #FFFFFF. Use the provided colors.
Translate content based on the IT/EN toggle (e.g., Orari -> Opening Hours).
